explication: Janssen is a suite of digital identity and access-management components, not one application. Its central user journey is an OAuth/OIDC authorization request handled by the Auth Server, which can involve authentication and session state before returning an authorization result. The repository also includes configurable authentication journeys (Agama), FIDO/passkey support, user-management APIs, administration tools, and authorization-policy products. Edges are limited to README-documented relationships or marked dashed where the sampled source does not establish wiring; the file tree and excerpts do not expose a complete end-to-end request path.
